cases.title: Prince George Airport Guards’ Light Report
cases.sourceQuality: Primary official flying object report from the 918th AC&W Squadron, released through PURSUE Release 07; two co-located guards, unaided visual, no radar or optical aids, no physical evidence, no independent corroboration. All distances and movements are visual estimates; a 135° disappearance elevation is a source ambiguity.

cases.title: Guam F-86D Blinking-Light Encounter
cases.sourceQuality: Primary official air intelligence report (IR-7-57) prepared by Capt Alan G. Pound, released through PURSUE Release 07; one pilot witness, no radar, no supporting observers. A lighted weather balloon was launched that day and the investigator explicitly retained a malfunctioned-balloon explanation.

cases.title: Saudi Arabia — B-52 Gunnery-Radar Contact
cases.sourceQuality: Primary official air intelligence report (IR-1-57) from the 22d Bombardment Wing, released through PURSUE Release 07; one gunner source and an explanatory radar schematic. No visual sighting, independent radar, raw radar recording, or calibrated tracking. Smaller return amplitude does not establish physical size.
